name: Camp Surefire
description_short: A one week overnight camp for children and teens with type 1 diabetes, held at Camp JORI in Wakefield. Campers do regular camp activities like swimming, the rock wall and campfires while volunteer medical staff and dietitians help them manage their diabetes; teens 15 to 17 can apply to be Leaders in Training.
refund_policy_summary: $50 of the $750 tuition is a non-refundable registration fee. Cancel before June 1 for a refund minus that fee; no refunds after June 1, with partial refunds considered for documented medical reasons.
special_needs_notes: For campers with type 1 diabetes. Volunteer medical staff (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN or diabetes educators) stay next to the cabins and monitor blood sugars around the clock; camp supplies insulin, meters, strips and low treatments, and families bring pump and CGM supplies.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp JORI has a lake and two swimming pools; the activity list names swimming in the pool.

for_andrew: Start date conflict on the camp's own site: Camp Dates page says August 15-21, 2027 and the FAQ says August 16-21, 2027. I used August 15 (a Sunday, the usual overnight drop off day). Worth asking the owner.
The $750 tuition is not labeled with a year on the tuition page; I took it from the FAQ, which is written for 2027. Confirm it is the 2027 price.
Wakefield is about 45 minutes from Providence, at the edge of the metro range.
